evidence.quote: Counsel initially proposed a $30 million class fund and $5 million in fees and expenses.
Class relief and attorneys’ fees were negotiated concurrently from the opening proposal; fees were not reserved until after agreement on class relief.
Any fees not awarded will supplement the class fund, not revert to Brightline.

summary: Class counsel raised fees in the opening proposal, and the final declaration confirms that fees and class relief were negotiated concurrently rather than after class relief was fixed. Fee reductions or unawarded fees were expressly tied to increasing the class fund, but the transcript does not show class counsel prioritizing firm economics over the class. Defense did not use fee interests as leverage or disclose competing negotiations, and the court declaration appears consistent with the negotiation history.
